---
title: "Application Management RLS (OAuth Schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_op: request on oauth.applications
    q_check_op --> q_admin_check_insert: operation = INSERT
    q_check_op --> q_admin_check_select: operation = SELECT
    q_check_op --> q_admin_check_update: operation = UPDATE
    q_check_op --> q_admin_check_delete: operation = DELETE

    q_admin_check_insert --> q_allow_insert: member.members.is_admin = true AND id = auth.uid()
    q_admin_check_insert --> q_deny: NOT is_admin
    q_allow_insert --> [*]: row inserted

    q_admin_check_select --> q_allow_select: member.members.is_admin = true AND id = auth.uid()
    q_admin_check_select --> q_deny: NOT is_admin
    q_allow_select --> [*]: rows returned

    q_admin_check_update --> q_allow_update: member.members.is_admin = true AND id = auth.uid()
    q_admin_check_update --> q_deny: NOT is_admin
    q_allow_update --> [*]: row updated

    q_admin_check_delete --> q_allow_delete: member.members.is_admin = true AND id = auth.uid()
    q_admin_check_delete --> q_deny: NOT is_admin
    q_allow_delete --> [*]: row deleted

    q_deny --> [*]: access denied (RLS violation)

    note right of q_admin_check_insert
        INV-001: Only users with is_admin=true in member.members can INSERT applications
        INV-002: Admin check uses auth.uid() to match member.members.id
        INV-003: client_id must be UNIQUE across all applications
        INV-004: client_secret_hash stores bcrypt hash, never plaintext
        INV-005: redirect_uris is a TEXT array of allowed redirect URIs
    end note

    note right of q_deny
        INV-006: All four CRUD operations require identical admin check
        INV-007: Non-admin users cannot access any application records
    end note

---
title: "Authorization Code Lifecycle (OAuth Schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_create: server creates auth code (service role)
    q_create --> q_store: INSERT into oauth.authorization_codes
    q_store --> q_active: code stored with expires_at = NOW() + 10min

    q_active --> q_validate: token exchange request arrives
    q_active --> q_expired: expires_at < NOW()

    q_validate --> q_check_app: verify application_id exists
    q_check_app --> q_check_redirect: application_id valid
    q_check_app --> q_reject: application_id invalid
    q_check_redirect --> q_check_pkce: redirect_uri matches stored value
    q_check_redirect --> q_reject: redirect_uri mismatch
    q_check_pkce --> q_exchange: code_challenge verified (S256)
    q_check_pkce --> q_exchange: no PKCE required
    q_check_pkce --> q_reject: PKCE verification failed
    q_exchange --> q_consumed: code consumed, issue token
    q_consumed --> [*]: token issued

    q_expired --> q_cleanup: cleanup_expired_codes() runs
    q_cleanup --> [*]: expired code deleted

    q_reject --> [*]: token exchange rejected

    note right of q_active
        INV-001: Authorization codes expire after 10 minutes (expires_at)
        INV-002: RLS policy denies ALL direct access (USING false)
        INV-003: Only service role key can access authorization_codes table
        INV-004: code is PRIMARY KEY, ensuring uniqueness
    end note

    note right of q_check_pkce
        INV-005: PKCE code_challenge_method must be S256 when present
        INV-006: code_challenge is optional (PKCE not mandatory)
        INV-007: Default scope is 'openid profile'
    end note

    note right of q_check_redirect
        INV-008: redirect_uri at exchange must match redirect_uri at code creation
        INV-009: application.redirect_uris array constrains valid redirect URIs
    end note

---
title: "User Consent Management (OAuth Schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_request: user consent operation requested

    q_request --> q_insert: operation = INSERT
    q_request --> q_select: operation = SELECT
    q_request --> q_delete: operation = DELETE

    q_insert --> q_allow_insert: INSERT policy WITH CHECK (true)
    q_allow_insert --> q_check_unique: check UNIQUE(user_id, application_id)
    q_check_unique --> q_stored: constraint satisfied
    q_check_unique --> q_conflict: duplicate consent exists
    q_stored --> [*]: consent granted

    q_conflict --> [*]: unique violation error

    q_select --> q_check_owner_select: user_id = auth.uid()
    q_check_owner_select --> q_return_rows: owner verified
    q_check_owner_select --> q_empty: not owner
    q_return_rows --> [*]: consent records returned
    q_empty --> [*]: empty result set (RLS filtered)

    q_delete --> q_check_owner_delete: user_id = auth.uid()
    q_check_owner_delete --> q_do_delete: owner verified
    q_check_owner_delete --> q_no_delete: not owner
    q_do_delete --> [*]: consent revoked
    q_no_delete --> [*]: no rows deleted (RLS filtered)

    note right of q_allow_insert
        INV-001: INSERT policy is WITH CHECK (true) - any authenticated user can create consent
        INV-002: No check that user_id = auth.uid() on INSERT - server sets user_id
        INV-003: UNIQUE(user_id, application_id) enforces one consent per user per app
    end note

    note right of q_check_owner_select
        INV-004: SELECT restricted to rows where user_id = auth.uid()
        INV-005: DELETE restricted to rows where user_id = auth.uid()
        INV-006: No UPDATE policy exists - consents cannot be modified after creation
    end note

---
title: "cleanup_expired_codes (OAuth Schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_invoke: call oauth.cleanup_expired_codes()
    q_invoke --> q_scan: scan authorization_codes table
    q_scan --> q_check: for each code, check expires_at < NOW()
    q_check --> q_delete: expires_at < NOW() (expired)
    q_check --> q_skip: expires_at >= NOW() (still valid)
    q_delete --> q_check: continue to next code
    q_skip --> q_check: continue to next code
    q_check --> q_done: all codes processed
    q_done --> [*]: return void

    note right of q_invoke
        INV-001: Function is SECURITY DEFINER (runs with owner privileges)
        INV-002: Bypasses RLS policies on authorization_codes table
        INV-003: Function should be called periodically (cron recommended)
    end note

    note right of q_delete
        INV-004: DELETE WHERE expires_at < NOW() removes all expired codes in one operation
        INV-005: CASCADE on application_id means deleting an application also removes its codes
    end note

---
title: "Schema Referential Integrity (OAuth Schema)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_fk: referential integrity check on mutation

    q_check_fk --> q_app_fk: mutation on oauth.applications
    q_check_fk --> q_code_fk: mutation on oauth.authorization_codes
    q_check_fk --> q_consent_fk: mutation on oauth.user_consents

    q_app_fk --> q_app_delete: DELETE application
    q_app_delete --> q_cascade_codes: CASCADE delete authorization_codes
    q_app_delete --> q_cascade_consents: CASCADE delete user_consents
    q_cascade_codes --> q_cascade_consents
    q_cascade_consents --> [*]: application and dependents removed

    q_app_fk --> q_app_created_by: created_by references auth.users(id)
    q_app_created_by --> q_set_null: ON DELETE SET NULL
    q_set_null --> [*]: created_by set to NULL

    q_code_fk --> q_code_check_app: application_id must exist in oauth.applications
    q_code_fk --> q_code_check_user: user_id must exist in auth.users
    q_code_check_app --> q_code_valid: FK satisfied
    q_code_check_app --> q_code_reject: FK violation
    q_code_check_user --> q_code_valid
    q_code_check_user --> q_code_reject
    q_code_valid --> [*]: code operation succeeds
    q_code_reject --> [*]: FK constraint error

    q_consent_fk --> q_consent_check_app: application_id must exist in oauth.applications
    q_consent_fk --> q_consent_check_user: user_id must exist in auth.users
    q_consent_check_app --> q_consent_valid: FK satisfied
    q_consent_check_app --> q_consent_reject: FK violation
    q_consent_check_user --> q_consent_valid
    q_consent_check_user --> q_consent_reject
    q_consent_valid --> [*]: consent operation succeeds
    q_consent_reject --> [*]: FK constraint error

    note right of q_app_delete
        INV-001: Deleting an application cascades to all its authorization_codes
        INV-002: Deleting an application cascades to all its user_consents
        INV-003: Deleting a user cascades authorization_codes and user_consents
    end note

    note right of q_app_created_by
        INV-004: applications.created_by uses ON DELETE SET NULL (not CASCADE)
        INV-005: Application persists even if creating admin user is deleted
    end note

---
title: "middleware (middleware.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_kiosk: request received
    q_check_kiosk --> q_kiosk_gate: pathname starts with /kiosk
    q_check_kiosk --> q_check_public: pathname does not start with /kiosk
    q_kiosk_gate --> q_kiosk_token_missing: kioskToken is undefined
    q_kiosk_gate --> q_kiosk_validate: kioskToken is defined
    q_kiosk_token_missing --> [*]: return 500 "Kiosk is not configured."
    q_kiosk_validate --> q_kiosk_invalid: token !== kioskToken
    q_kiosk_validate --> [*]: token === kioskToken, return NextResponse.next()
    q_kiosk_invalid --> [*]: redirect to /dashboard (clear query params)
    q_check_public --> q_public_pass: isPublicPath is true
    q_check_public --> q_oauth_check: isPublicPath is false
    q_oauth_check --> q_oauth_valid: oauthUserId AND oauthToken present
    q_oauth_check --> q_oauth_redirect: oauthUserId OR oauthToken missing
    q_oauth_valid --> [*]: return NextResponse.next()
    q_oauth_redirect --> [*]: redirect to /login
    q_public_pass --> [*]: return updateSession(request)

    note right of q_check_kiosk
        INV-001: All non-static requests are intercepted by middleware (matcher config)
        INV-002: Kiosk path check is evaluated before OAuth session check
    end note

    note right of q_kiosk_validate
        INV-003: Kiosk token comparison uses strict equality (===)
        INV-004: On invalid token, redirect clears query params to prevent token leakage in URL
    end note

    note right of q_oauth_check
        INV-005: OAuth session requires BOTH oauth_user_id AND oauth_access_token cookies
        INV-006: Public paths (/login, /auth/*) bypass OAuth check entirely
    end note

---
title: "kiosk_access_gate (middleware.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_get_token: token = searchParams.get("token")
    q_get_token --> q_env_check: kioskToken = process.env.KIOSK_ACCESS_TOKEN
    q_env_check --> q_error: kioskToken is falsy (not set)
    q_env_check --> q_compare: kioskToken is defined
    q_error --> [*]: return NextResponse 500
    q_compare --> q_invalid: token !== kioskToken
    q_compare --> [*]: token === kioskToken, return NextResponse.next()
    q_invalid --> q_build_redirect: clone request URL
    q_build_redirect --> q_clear_params: url.pathname = "/dashboard"
    q_clear_params --> [*]: url.search = "", return NextResponse.redirect(url)

    note right of q_get_token
        INV-001: Token is read from URL query parameter "token"
        INV-002: Token is compared against server-side env var KIOSK_ACCESS_TOKEN
    end note

    note right of q_compare
        INV-003: Comparison uses JavaScript === (not timing-safe comparison)
        INV-004: Failed auth redirects to /dashboard to hide kiosk existence
    end note

    note right of q_clear_params
        INV-005: Query parameters are cleared on redirect to prevent token leakage
    end note

---
title: "oauth_session_check (middleware.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_classify_path: isPublicPath = pathname starts with /login OR /auth/
    q_classify_path --> q_bypass: isPublicPath is true
    q_classify_path --> q_read_cookies: isPublicPath is false
    q_read_cookies --> q_check_session: oauthUserId = cookies.get("oauth_user_id"), oauthToken = cookies.get("oauth_access_token")
    q_check_session --> q_allow: oauthUserId AND oauthToken both present
    q_check_session --> q_deny: oauthUserId OR oauthToken missing
    q_allow --> [*]: return NextResponse.next()
    q_deny --> q_build_login_url: clone request URL
    q_build_login_url --> [*]: url.pathname = "/login", return NextResponse.redirect(url)
    q_bypass --> [*]: return updateSession(request)

    note right of q_classify_path
        INV-001: Public paths are /login and /auth/* only
        INV-002: Path matching uses startsWith (prefix match)
    end note

    note right of q_check_session
        INV-003: Session validity requires both cookie values to be truthy
        INV-004: No server-side token validation is performed (cookie presence only)
        INV-005: Cookie values are read but not verified against any backend
    end note

    note right of q_bypass
        INV-006: Public paths still call updateSession for Supabase session refresh
    end note

---
title: "route_matcher (middleware.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_match: incoming request path evaluated against matcher regex
    q_match --> q_skip: path matches exclusion (static, image, favicon, media files)
    q_match --> q_invoke: path does not match exclusion
    q_skip --> [*]: bypass middleware, serve directly
    q_invoke --> [*]: invoke middleware(request)

    note right of q_match
        INV-001: Excluded paths are _next/static, _next/image, favicon.ico, and media extensions (svg, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp)
        INV-002: Matcher uses negative lookahead regex pattern
        INV-003: All other paths (including API routes) pass through middleware
    end note
